messages:
sam: heads-up: enterprise wants a fully air-gapped POC; USB-only delivery, no outbound at runtime. asking for upgrade cadence options and rough uplift.

leah: noted. do they require monthly security patches or quarterly feature drops?

tony: engineering: monthly patches possible but more ops. need signed deltas, reproducible bundle, and a rollback plan. DB migrations complicate rollbacks.

sec_maya: security: require chain-of-trust doc, proof of no-call-home, and option to use customer HSM for signing. also need a sealed-mode SLA.

sam: customer insists on 7-14 day rollback window after each update. doable?

tony: image-level rollback yes (retain two prior versions). anything involving DB changes must be marked irreversible unless we provide migration rollbacks in SOW.

leah: commercial: typical uplift = one-time POC packaging fee + per-bundle handling. ballpark: $5k one-time + ~$600 per physical bundle, or labor-based eng-days.

ops_bot: reminder: include import dry-run, checksum verification, and staging import in runbook. recommended portable SSD for >32GB artifacts.

sam: ok pls draft a 1-page runbook + sample manifest + cost bullets by EOD PST. cc @sec_maya for addendum language.
